brief: Meant to pair an object with a condition that must always hold for it, such as a string that must stay lowercase.
detail: WARNING: no stzConstraint can be built today. The constructor calls IsConstraint, which calls RemoveFirstBoundQ on a string, a method that stzString does not have, so every construction raises R14. Once built it would also fail: Expression reads an unassigned variable and CheckConstraint always answers 0. The class is not used anywhere else in the library.
